summary: Casanéo iteration 19 — 3 new features end-to-end (backend + frontend): (1) PATCH /api/channel/sync-interval clamps 5..1440 & persists via GET /api/channel/status.sync_interval_min; (2) GET /api/deposits/pending returns future non-Airbnb reservations whose property has deposit_link set and no deposit_link_sent_at; (3) POST /api/reservations/{id}/send-deposit-link safely returns {sent:false, reason:'no_messaging'} on manual reservations (source!='lodgify' → NO real Lodgify send-message). Backend pytest 9/9 PASS (test_deposits_sync_interval.py): TestSyncInterval (4/4: status shape, valid 15/30/60/120/240 all persist, 1→5 clamp, 9999→1440 clamp), TestDepositsFlow (4/4: deposit_link persistence on Cosy Cocoon, manual reservation appears in /deposits/pending, send-deposit-link returns no_messaging, still listed after failed send), TestSendDepositLinkGuards (1/1: unknown rid → 404). Frontend (QA admin, 390x844): (a) Dashboard shows 'Cautions à envoyer' card with testID caution-toggle, deposit-row-<rid>, send-deposit-<rid>; tapping Envoyer on the seeded MANUAL Direct reservation does NOT remove the row (correct: no_messaging → row stays) and does not crash. (b) /settings/api-key shows 'Synchronisation automatique' section with chips testIDs sync-interval-15/-30/-60/-120/-240; tapping 1 h chip → backgroundColor becomes brandPrimary (rgb(28,28,30)) while 30 stays white; after page reload the 60-chip remains highlighted (persistence confirmed via GET /channel/status). (c) /property-form?id=<Cosy Cocoon> shows testID prop-deposit-link with the seeded value, round-trip via PUT confirmed. (d) /reservation-form?id=<manual Direct> displays the testID send-deposit-link button ('Envoyer le lien de caution au voyageur') alongside caution-validated-toggle. All test seed data cleaned up: manual reservation deleted, deposit_link restored to '', sync_interval_min restored to 30, /deposits/pending no longer contains the test rid.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L721-748 send_deposit_link correctly gates real Lodgify send behind (source=='lodgify' AND thread_uid AND lodgify_id) AND (channel_settings.api_key). Manual reservation (source=None, thread_uid=None) short-circuits with no_messaging and NO httpx call — safe guardrail confirmed by pytest + UI Envoyer tap without any Lodgify message.

server.py L751-779 deposits_pending: correct filter (deposit_link not empty on property, status!='annulee', check_in>=today, platform!='Airbnb', deposit_link_sent_at empty). Respects _prop_scope(user) for member accounts. ✔
server.py L1737-1743 set_sync_interval clamps minutes to [5..1440] before writing; robust against negative/absent/oversized inputs. ✔

index.tsx L214-245: 'Cautions à envoyer' card only mounts when canModify(user) && deposits.length>0 — read-only members won't see it. sendDeposit removes the row on success and shows FR Alert on no_deposit_link / no_messaging / no_channel. ✔
api-key.tsx L83-99: chip active state uses Number(status.sync_interval_min || 30) === m, resilient to null; disabling all chips during savingInt prevents concurrent writes. ✔

index.tsx L98: on RN web, Alert.alert may not fire a browser 'dialog' event (uses a custom modal), so the alert message wasn't captured by page.on('dialog', ...). The absence of removal from the deposits list is the observable proof of no_messaging path. Not a bug — just a note for future UI test authors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs verified: caution-toggle, deposit-row-<id>, send-deposit-<id>, sync-interval-{15,30,60,120,240}, prop-deposit-link, send-deposit-link)
